description: Lists and searches reminders in the Mac's Reminders, with each one's id. With id: that reminder in full, with its subtasks. With nothing: the lists with how many are open, then the open reminders (dated ones by due date first); subtasks stand indented under their reminder; ⚑ marks flagged ones, #name their tags. query matches title, notes, and tags; list limits to one list, names its sections, and says how many reminders it holds, open and completed. Open reminders: to keeps those due by then. completed: true lists completed ones instead, from from (default 30 days ago) to to (default now). Dates: YYYY-MM-DD, or YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM in the Mac's time zone (optionally with Z or ±HH:MM).

completed.description: List completed reminders instead of open ones

from.description: For completed: completed on or after

id.description: A reminder's id, to read it in full

limit.description: At most this many (default 50, up to 200)

machine.description: The machine to use, by name, as the machines tool lists it. Leave it out when only one machine offers this tool.

query.description: Words in the title or notes

to.description: Open: due by; completed: completed by

name: reminders_find
title: Find Reminders
